limitations.note: The rewrite preserves behavior for 0 and 1 but changes four-state simulation: an X or Z on valid_in now holds the counter and data registers instead of allowing the original ternary assignments to propagate uncertainty.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: Verification took three attempts: the first command was rejected before simulation, and the second reported a false mismatch because the testbench left valid_in high across reset release and failed to count an accepted word.
